ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white/grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity pigmentation band along the trailing edge; extensive high-intensity mottling across the lower basal regions of both lobes; distinct vertical low-intensity linear feature on the right lobe at approximately 70% of the horizontal span.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 62 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical pixel height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 5 to 12 pixels along the interior margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a concave sweep trajectory leading to acute, medially-curved (hooked) terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups located at the extreme terminal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent near-vertical low-intensity linear disruption on the right lobe; multiple secondary horizontal and diagonal linear disruptions visible within the high-intensity mottled zones.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major vertical linear scar on the mid-right lobe; substantial scarring/pigmentation loss clusters at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'toothed' serration pattern localized near the base of the median notch.
